name: chief-of-staff
description: Run many work streams like a small company: a Chief of Staff, a Production VP, a Communication VP and one COO per project, with short briefs and decisions as clear choices.

interface.shortDescription: Run your work like a team
interface.longDescription:
Chief of Staff is an operating model for people who run many projects and work streams at once. A Chief of Staff keeps track of everything, says what really waits on you and routes new work. A Production VP holds one quality standard and checks that work is verified before it is called done. A Communication VP drafts and routes what you want said. One COO per project turns your direction into monthly goals and hands work to helpers.

The app explains each role, shows a demo brief and points to the open source project. It is read-only, needs no sign-in and has no access to your data. Decisions come to you as short choices with a recommendation first.

Open source (MIT): https://github.com/GutenGroup/chief-of-staff
capabilities: Explain each role in the operating model
Show what a daily brief looks like
Point to the open source install and docs
Plan the day across many work streams
Hold a build and quality standard
defaultPrompt: What does a Chief of Staff brief look like?
Explain what a project COO does.
How do I install Chief of Staff?

positive.prompt: What is the Chief of Staff system and what roles does it have?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains the Chief of Staff, Production VP, Communication VP, project COO, worker and Helm roles in plain language.

positive.prompt: What does the Production VP do in Chief of Staff?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with role production-vp and explains the quality bar: work is done only when verified live.

positive.prompt: Show me an example of a Chief of Staff brief.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the demo brief with what needs the owner, what is moving and what stalled, and says it is demo data.

positive.prompt: How do I install Chief of Staff?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the open source repository, the getting-started guide and the documentation links.

positive.prompt: Explain what a project COO does.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with role project-coo and explains that one COO per project turns direction into monthly goals and hands work to helpers.

negative.prompt: Read my email and tell me what needs me.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Chief of Staff 1.8.0: autonomous and proactive. Only legal, money and big or irreversible steps reach you, as ready packets with a recommendation; every role looks first before it acts.
